children: expects its investment banking fees to drop to between $1.6 billion to $1.8 billion in the third quarter, at least a 10% drop from $2 billion in the same period a year earlier, CEO Brian Moynihan said on Monday.
"What we're seeing is the market generally in investment banking is down 10% or so" he said at the Barclays global financial services conference.
